cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
emp=wb['Emp']; look=wb['Lookup']
vars_cols=['E','F','G','H','I','J']
lookup={look.cell(r,1).value:(look.cell(r,2).value, look.cell(r,3).value) for r in range(2,8)}
ws=wb['Expected']
r=2
for er in range(2,5):
    seq=emp.cell(er,1).value; eno=emp.cell(er,2).value; en=emp.cell(er,3).value; job=emp.cell(er,4).value
    for c in vars_cols:
        var=emp[c+'1'].value; val=emp[c+str(er)].value; cat,sub=lookup[var]
        ws.cell(r,1,seq); ws.cell(r,2,eno); ws.cell(r,3,en); ws.cell(r,4,job)
        ws.cell(r,5,var); ws.cell(r,6,cat); ws.cell(r,7,sub); ws.cell(r,8,val)
        r+=1
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
